violated_contract: Paid-through cancel grace may keep a paid plan after a subscription reaches status canceled only when the current period was paid. A renewal that dunning, a void or an uncollectible mark left unpaid also ends canceled with a future current_period_end; projecting it as an active paid plan re-grants the whole unpaid period, and because entitlement reads only the stored row, nothing later corrects it.
canonical_prevention: Gate the grace branch on the subscription's latest invoice having status paid (read from Stripe when the event carries only its id, and retry the webhook on a read failure rather than guess). End an existing grace when invoice.voided or invoice.marked_uncollectible arrives for the latest invoice of a canceled subscription that is still the user's stored paid subscription; leave superseded invoices of live subscriptions alone. Pin unpaid, voided, uncollectible, missing and string-id invoice cases with webhook characterization tests.
